_source: ANSI/ASME B4.1-1967 (R1987) Tables 1-5, transcribed from a third-party HTML copy and checked by tools/extract_ansi.py; see data/README.md
_units: thousandths of an inch (0.001 in); sizes in inches (over, up to and including)
_convention: fit = [minimum, maximum] clearance; negative = interference. hole/shaft = [upper, lower] deviation from basic size.

rows.review: Shaft u6 tolerance is 3.5 thou here; every other FN4 row (and IT6 for this range, 2.5) suggests +42.5/+40.0 and interference 36.0-42.5. The source prints 43.5 in both the fit and the shaft cells. VERIFY AGAINST THE PRINTED STANDARD.

Machinery's Handbook (1533) and ANSI B4.1 print shaft f8 = -1.0/-3.0 for this row, but also clearance 1.2-6.0 and an f8 tolerance of 1.8 (IT8 for 1.97-3.15 in), which both require -1.2/-3.0. The engine uses -1.2/-3.0; a hand calculation from the printed shaft limits gives a minimum clearance of 1.0.
Shaft g5 tolerance is 4 thou here; H5 for this range is 6 (RC1 hole), which would give -8/-14 and clearance 8-24. The source prints 22 and -12 consistently. VERIFY AGAINST THE PRINTED STANDARD.
